name: Domino Beach
source: A young and ambitious man arrives in Domino Beach, the sunny city of his dreams, hoping to start a new life. But from the very beginning, nothing goes according to plan: he loses his job and then gets evicted from his apartment. By a twist of fate, he gets a chance to prove himself and join the team of beach lifeguards, with tryouts happening in a week. Will he be able to overcome this challenge, surrounded by so many temptations: beautiful girls, daredevil surfers, wild parties, and an ocean of alcohol?​
translation: 一位雄心勃勃的年轻人来到了他梦想中的阳光城市多米诺海滩，希望开始新的生活。但从一开始，一切都没有按计划进行：他丢了工作，然后被赶出公寓。命运的安排让他有机会证明自己并加入海滩救生员队伍，并在一周后进行选拔。他能否克服这个被众多诱惑包围的挑战：美丽的女孩、大胆的冲浪者、狂野的派对和酒精的海洋？​
